scope: Selected primary scientific passages and pinned implementation reads. No exhaustive novelty clearance.

sources.title: ActionMesh
sources.note: The topology-preserving animation stage consumes temporal shape latents and anchor queries. The inspected implementation predicts bounded absolute coordinates in direct mode. A proposed displacement correction must use F_t(x)-x rather than assume the tensor is an additive displacement. Learned temporal animation is already prior work.

sources.title: Fast 4D Mesh Generation by Spatio-Temporal Attention Chains
sources.locators: Sections 3, 4.1-4.4; Appendix B and C; equations 2-5
sources.note: Attention-chain matching, landmark filtering, confidence-weighted Gaussian smoothing and geodesic rigid skinning are covered. Appendix B reports a small motion-metric disadvantage relative to the learned ActionMesh animator at matched denoising steps, despite geometric gains. That motivates investigating a geometry/motion tradeoff; it does not prove a common cause. The long-sequence stress extension uses artificial forward/reverse looping, which will not be used as our natural long-video evidence. No released implementation link was located on the inspected project page. The printed confidence normalization needs implementation clarification; a row-constant factor mathematically cancels.

sources.title: Mesh4D
sources.locators: Section 3.1-3.2, especially deformation representation and skeleton information
sources.note: A compact whole-animation deformation representation and skeleton-informed training are established alternatives. A low-rank repair is not the invention of an animation latent, and training with privileged skeletons is outside our frozen-weight budget. Its released-model/evaluator compatibility remains unqualified here.

sources.title: Optimizing Mesh Animation from Video via Shape Flow Guidance
sources.locators: Pages 4-9, task and Sections 4.1-4.2; equations 2-12; experimental setup and limitations passages
sources.note: The method already uses initial-shape plus latent-trajectory difference, coupled temporal transport, root-space local/global decomposition, post-skinning correction, and ARAP regularization. Thus anchor subtraction and motion/shape separation alone are not original contributions. C01 acts on decoded coordinates rather than sampling trajectories; C02 needs a specific protected observation operator beyond this decomposition; C14 is a strong baseline with overlap. The evaluation uses rendered-video/shape metrics on a different dataset, so its scores cannot be substituted for native ActionBench geometry/motion evidence. Released-code and full function-level qualification remain pending.

sources.note: Entropic optimal transport and matrix scaling are existing mathematical tools. Area balancing and KL scaling will be attributed, not presented as new inventions.
